main_measure.name: mean short-signed next-day return minus coin mean daily return, over forecast<0 bars

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases grouped by day

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 (day-clustered) and check > 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: top-half minus bottom-half |forecast| mean short-signed unusual move

decided_by: Mean above 0 with t >= 2 and top-minus-bottom |forecast| half difference above 0.
reading: Situation from run_depth raw value > 0 (prices where unrecorded) and 60-bar in-window price return < -10 % (detector's regime where 60 bars are not available); cases with no next bar in the window are left out; top half = the n//2 cases with largest |forecast| (stable sort), bottom half = the rest; the 100-case minimum is applied as 'not observable'.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.001024 on the check folds against +0.005515 on every fold
